label: Wait until
description: Pause this branch until a date and time, at no cost: the run parks on a timer and resumes when it fires. `when` is ISO-8601 (`2026-09-03T09:00:00Z`, or with an offset) and must be in the future. Whatever arrives on `value` comes out unchanged afterwards; `wokeAt` is when it resumed. To wait for a duration instead, use Wait.

inputs.name: when
inputs.label: When
inputs.description: The ISO-8601 date and time to resume at, e.g. `2026-09-03T09:00:00Z` or `2026-09-03T11:00:00+02:00`. Must be in the future.

inputs.name: value
inputs.label: Value
inputs.description: Passed through unchanged once the time has come. Optional: the node also works as a pure delay on `_should_flow`.

outputs.name: value
outputs.description: The `value` that came in, emitted once the time has come.
